summary: For s with a tame exponent at A, the local compatibility of the avatar at w (stably unramified E) gives the polynomial X − ιℓ(θ_w(x)) killing s; θ_w(x) is computed through the label of ψ_w.

steps.claim: Not a step of the proof: the rest of the statement (IsLabelledAt A T f (PolyKillsAt μ A) (X − x_{ψ_w}) with T = faithfulChar of the residue field), which the line census counts as part of the value because the statement contains `let T :=`. The statement is read in the member's text.
steps.lean:
faithfulChar (ResField w); IsLabelledAt A T f (PolyKillsAt ((scalar
    (Fin 1)).comp (h.toAlgebraic k j).avatar) A) (X - C (charName T (ψ w)).1) :=

steps.claim: Let s have tame exponent y at A (hy: A lies over w, s is in inertia at A, and the residue of s acts on a (q_w^f − 1)-th root of a uniformiser through T as the y-th power of a fixed root of unity).
steps.lean:
fun s y hy ↦ by
  choose x a b H using
    (avatarCompatAt_of_stablyUnram (h.toAlgebraic k j) hy.1).2.2 s 0 bot_le (inv_mem hy.2.2.1)
  simpa [*, hy.pow_apply_charName _ a b, toAlgebraic, baseChange_finPart_locIdele,
    charUnramifiedAt_upsilon ..] using H

steps.claim: By the local compatibility of the avatar at the places above w (avatarCompatAt_of_stablyUnram: E is a stably unramified CM field), applied with degree 0 to s, whose inverse lies in inertia: s is the local Artin image of a local unit x, and X − ιℓ(θ(x)) kills s on μ at A, θ = h.toAlgebraic k j.
steps.lean:
choose x a b H using
    (avatarCompatAt_of_stablyUnram (h.toAlgebraic k j) hy.1).2.2 s 0 bot_le (inv_mem hy.2.2.1)

steps.claim: θ(x) = ψ_w(residue of x) (the base change of a at a local unit is given by its tame part, and υ is unramified at w), and ψ_w(residue of x) = T(x_{ψ_w})^y (IsTameExponent.pow_apply_charName); so the killing polynomial is X − ιℓ(T(x_{ψ_w})^y), as required.
steps.lean:
simpa [*, hy.pow_apply_charName _ a b, toAlgebraic, baseChange_finPart_locIdele,
    charUnramifiedAt_upsilon ..] using H
